card.title: Record My Contribution
card.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you put my name under 'cake design' before you frame our club's prize certificate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Next year's members won't. There's a blank ready for them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually credit the whole baking team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: List us all, with what each did. I'll fetch everyone's names before you seal the frame.

mechanism: A secures named contribution credit on a certificate before framing makes the collective account durable.
confusable: Unlike competing to erase others' work, A needs a lasting record of who did what.
comparison: A team-role list becomes the compromise, unlike village minutes recording a single repair and pending thanks.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
